notes: `baseline-type-coverage` spawn `pnpm exec` (`pnpmCommand()`), so in a bun
project (teleporte-web, 2026-10-19) the first run made pnpm 12 install
itself: an untracked `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and a second

result: baseline-dupes and baseline-type-coverage resolve the consumer-installed Node CLI directly, including hoisted workspace dependencies; arguments and failure behavior are preserved without invoking a package manager.
evidence: Four CLI regressions failed before the change; pnpm --filter @syntopica/quality-config test --maxWorkers=1 passed 9 files and 32 tests; lint and type-check passed. Real jscpd scanned a temporary source fixture and type-coverage measured 5/5 identifiers with empty PATH and no manager; no pnpm lock/workspace files were created. Independent review found no issues. Source correction only, not an npm publication.
